query:
insert into SkippedTestRuns (
                product_id,
                test_run_name
            )
            with TestRunsWithSkippedTestCase (
                product_id,
                test_run_name
            ) as (
                select
                    product_id,
                    test_run_name
                from ResolvedTestCaseStates
                where state = $1
            ), IndirectSkippedTestRun (
                product_id,
                test_run_name
            ) as (
                select
                    d.product_id,
                    d.test_run_name
                from TestRunDescendants d, TestRunsWithSkippedTestCase s
                where d.product_id = s.product_id
                and d.descendant_test_run_name = s.test_run_name
            )
            select
                product_id,
                test_run_name
            from (
                select
                    product_id,
                    test_run_name
                from TestRunsWithSkippedTestCase

                union all

                select
                    product_id,
                    test_run_name
                from IndirectSkippedTestRun
            )

            except

            select
                product_id,
                test_run_name
            from FailedTestRuns
